recipe.visualDefinition: A centered portrait of a woman with multi-colored hair wearing a lavender faux fur jacket over a white tank top, set against a repetitive purple rhinestone-studded background. The style is defined by high-contrast lighting, a cool-toned color palette, and decorative, jeweled graphic elements characteristic of the early 2000s urban pop aesthetic.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's lavender fur jacket harmonizes with the purple textured background
High-key white tank top provides a central focal point against dark surroundings
Jeweled typography mirrors the circular rhinestone pattern in the background
Multi-colored hair streaks (purple, blue, black) bridge the subject to the background palette
coreInvariants: Repetitive grid of circular rhinestones in the background
Cool-toned purple and lavender color dominance
Soft-focus texture on the faux fur jacket
Decorative jeweled outline on the primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot, centered subject from waist up, occupying approximately 60% of the frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright white tank top at the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down to the white top, then right to the decorative logo, and finally to the belt detail.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The purple rhinestone background provides textured negative space on the left and right sides.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep purple and lavender (background and jacket)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white (tank top and rhinestone highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white clothing and deep purple background; medium saturation throughout.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid warm tones like orange or yellow
Limit to cool purples, blues, and neutral whites/blacks

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Rounded, lowercase-heavy script with exaggerated loops
letterConstructionRules: Inner stroke filled with a repeating dot/rhinestone pattern
Soft drop shadow to separate from background
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'i' uses a circular dot that mimics a rhinestone
Terminal strokes are rounded and bulbous
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative logo paired with small, metallic sans-serif for secondary details.

preserve: The jeweled fill of the letters

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Custom vector lettering based on 'Puffy' or 'Candy' styles
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the soft, rounded volume of the original

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A portrait of a woman with purple and blue hair streaks wearing a lavender faux fur jacket and white tank top, standing against a wall of purple rhinestones. Soft lighting, 2000s photography style.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom rounded script lettering in the upper right. The letters should have a double outline and be filled with a rhinestone pattern.

verificationChecks: Is the background a consistent grid of purple gems?
Does the typography feature a jeweled/rhinestone fill?
Is the color palette strictly cool-toned (purple/blue/white)?
Is the jacket texture visibly soft and furry?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the fur on the jacket
Opacity of the text drop shadow
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not look like a standard system font.
Ensure the rhinestone background doesn't look like simple polka dots.
Verify the fur texture looks realistic and soft.
Confirm the purple tones are consistent across the image.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a textured 'bling' background with a soft-focus fashion portrait and custom-jeweled typography to recreate the early 2000s R&B visual identity.
